description: Data of a 6-bus power system and 5-node natural gas system (Example) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Sheng Chen. This is the example data of the paper "Natural Gas as Transition Green Energy: Emission Penalty/Incentive vs. Green Energy Target". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 45820 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
